column1: # Exactly three tab-separated columns: kind, depth, expected outcome.
# `depth` counts generated source containers. `expected outcome` is only OK or
# ERR evaluation_limit. Deep successes are not recursively rendered; both
# runners iteratively verify every generated container and the terminal value.
# Every shape must clear the former TypeScript-only ceiling at depth 501.
# The shared conversion limit is 10,000 live frames. A root paren also uses an
# implicit top-level item frame, so its source-level boundary is one lower.
